decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so moving is allowed. C512-10 holds 136 t at 13.4 g/t, about 58.6 oz. N574-15 holds 168 t at 9.4 g/t, about 50.8 oz. LH-08 (infrastructure heading, 0.5 oz/h) goes to N574-15: 0.34 h travel, 30 t/h, about 5.6 h to clear it, cost about 3 oz. LH-09 (2.0 oz/h) goes to C512-10: 0.74 h travel, 29 t/h, about 4.7 h, cost about 11 oz. Truck capacity is above inflow at both mines (Norte 66 vs 33, Central 91 vs about 92), so neither is truck-limited. Net is roughly 95 oz less repair-return uncertainty. LH-10 is in PM until 14:00, so I did not use it. I took no loader from a producing stope.
